vardsidan.forkl_spelet: The wanderers only see each other when they stand in the same room, and each has their own map with the rooms they have walked through themselves. Tracks and sounds through the walls tell where the others might be. If they want to know what the tower looks like, they have to tell each other. The tower's size, the sun and the turn time follow the number of wanderers. The wanderers always choose a class after the lobby and can fight each other except in the gate rooms. The wandering starts by itself once at least two are ready, AI players included.
vardsidan.forkl_svarighet: How dangerous the tower is: lives, how often new rooms have traps and creatures, how many sleep and wake cards the serpent deck has, how hard the serpent bites and how much treasure is lost when it wakes. Normal is the data files as they are.
vardsidan.forkl_ai: Computer-controlled wanderers who fill in when you are few. They only see what a human sees, get no clues and never whisper. If the tower is full when a human arrives, one of them makes room. At most seven.
vardsidan.forkl_sprak: The language of the game and the keeper page. Changes at once in the lobby, otherwise from the next tower.
vardsidan.forkl_avslojande: The tower holds a secret that shows itself gradually as the sun sinks, in four levels: rooms, sounds and the map change, the wanderers get different clues and omens about nearby rooms, and the epilogue tells all. Whoever understands the secret can whisper it to the tower with V and become initiated. Each wandering gives the serpent its own name in three parts, handed out to the wanderers, and the whisper must contain it. Towards the end the tower grows more dangerous: from level 3 some traps become more common, and at the last level the gates close one by one. Turn it off for those who only want the treasure, the serpent and the dark.
vardsidan.forkl_franvaro: What happens to a human who loses the connection during the wandering: an AI player takes over after this many rounds, or the wanderer stands still until the human returns. The same goes for someone who is still there but chooses no move for as many rounds in a row; they get their steps back with their next move.
vardsidan.hjalp_wifi: Check that everyone is on the same wifi. Guest networks often stop devices from reaching each other.
vardsidan.hjalp_local: If the name with .local does not work, try the address with numbers.
vardsidan.hjalp_macos: Did macOS ask whether the game may accept network connections? Then you must have answered Allow. You can change it under System Settings → Network → Firewall.
vardsidan.hjalp_tappar: Anyone who loses the connection goes back to the address in the same browser and gets their wanderer back, with the same name.
vardsidan.hjalp_sida_lanken: Check that the whole link came through, including the part after #. Copy it again with Copy link.
vardsidan.hjalp_sida_natet: Some networks block the connection, most often mobile networks and networks at work and school. Try another network, for example wifi instead of mobile data.
vardsidan.hjalp_sida_fliken: The tower's tab must stay open for the whole journey. If it is closed or reloaded the tower closes, and everyone has to start over.
vardsidan.hjalp_sida_tappar: Anyone who loses the connection opens the link again and types the same name.
